abstract: Manages heavy lift offshore support vessel dynamic positioning records and transit scheduling
system_message:
You are the Marine operations superintendent (MOS), responsible for managing heavy lift offshore support vessel dynamic positioning records, transit scheduling, and vessel deck load management.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages heavy lift offshore support vessel dynamic positioning records and transit scheduling（DPVESSEL）
information_points.content:
MOS-DPVESSEL-6YX：For the Modular Hyperbaric Habitat System, the marine warranty surveyor vessel audit certificate confirms that dynamic positioning class-3 vessel verification has been validated for the assigned primary subsea support vessel under design sea-state conditions.
MOS-DPVESSEL-DZT：For the Sleeve Enclosure Rapid Hot-Tap System, the marine warranty surveyor vessel audit certificate indicates that dynamic positioning class-3 vessel verification has not been validated for the assigned primary subsea support vessel under design sea-state conditions.
MOS-DPVESSEL-BC2：For the Remotely Deployed Mechanical Tie-in System, the marine warranty surveyor vessel audit certificate confirms that dynamic positioning class-3 vessel verification has been validated for the assigned primary subsea support vessel under design sea-state conditions.

information_points.title: Vessel deck load management（DECKAREA）
information_points.content:
MOS-DECKAREA-ZOR：According to the vessel general arrangement drawing for the Remotely Deployed Mechanical Tie-in System, the unobstructed clear working deck area on the candidate primary intervention support vessel aft deck is 850 m^2.
MOS-DECKAREA-OLS：According to the vessel general arrangement drawing for the Sleeve Enclosure Rapid Hot-Tap System, the unobstructed clear working deck area on the candidate primary intervention support vessel aft deck is 1,400 m^2.
MOS-DECKAREA-SSR：According to the vessel general arrangement drawing for the Modular Hyperbaric Habitat System, the unobstructed clear working deck area on the candidate primary intervention support vessel aft deck is 1,100 m^2.
